testcase.name: Scenario: Reopen ribbon customization at its default size after resizing: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1771:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen ribbon customization at its default size after resizing ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and ribbon customization is open with no pending edits ✔ When the user drags the lower-right dialog corner outward ✔ Then the dialog and its command lists become wider and taller ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ And the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon in the same session ✔ Then the dialog reopens at its default size ✔ And the available-command and custom-panel lists remain visible
